findings.evidence: Lines 83–96 construct continuity solely via `FiniteDimensional.complete` and `LinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap`; Mathlib `Representation.character` and `char_one` are stated over `[Field k]`, while `char_mul_comm` even omits finite dimensionality.
findings.fix: Generalize the `Monoid` and `Group` sections (including `character`, `character_one`, `character_mul_comm`, `character_trivial`, `character_restrict`, and `character_conj`) to `[NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜] [CompleteSpace 𝕜]`; retain `RCLike` only for the inner-product sections.
findings.issue: The basic character packaging and algebraic API require `[RCLike 𝕜]`, although their construction only uses continuity of trace on a finite-dimensional space over a complete nontrivially normed field. This excludes natural scalar fields unnecessarily.

summary: The continuous character API is unnecessarily restricted to real/complex scalars.
